title: limonium latifolium
intro: Limonium latifolium, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a flowering plant species in the family Plumbaginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can help soothe wounds and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Sea Lavender include its analgesic and antioxidant properties, making it a popular natural remedy for pain relief and protection against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Limonium latifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
